findings.title: PROVEN broken function-level authorization: userA was denied GET http://127.0.0.1:8931/api/v1/admin and then granted it by client-supplied input
findings.description: Same identity, same route: 403 then 200. The authorization decision changes with a client-controlled value, so the client can grant itself the privileged response. Denied body: {"err": "forbidden"}. Granted body: {"flag": "flag{local_toolchain_validation_only}"}.

findings.title: PROVEN insecure deserialization: pickle (python protocol 0) payload on http://127.0.0.1:8931/deser was decoded by the server
findings.description: POSTing a valid pickle (python protocol 0) payload whose decoded value is the sentinel PHDSER94 returned 200 with the sentinel present: "ok 'PHDSER94'". The sentinel was never sent as plain text, so the server must have deserialized the object. Control: the same string as plain text returned 400 without the sentinel.

findings.title: PROVEN mass assignment: role is accepted from the client and persists
findings.description: POST with {"role": "pentharness-massassign-role-49220311"} returned 200 and the value was echoed. A separate follow-up request carrying none of that input still returned 200 with the value present: {"name":"user1","role":"pentharness-massassign-role-49220311"}. A field the client UI never sends controls server state.
